interval_years.quote: A license shall be granted for a period of two years and shall expire on December 31 in the second year.

required.quote: the license may be renewed upon submission of an application for renewal, including proof of continued certification by the certifying entity and payment of the renewal fee

available.quote: The department shall issue a license to an individual who is actively licensed as a behavior analyst in another state that currently imposes comparable licensing requirements as those imposed in this state and that offers reciprocity to individuals licensed under this chapter.

requirements.value: Applicant must be actively licensed in another state with comparable requirements that offers reciprocity to Alabama licensees; must submit proof of ethical compliance, current licensing, current BACB certification, and satisfactory criminal background check.
requirements.quote: An applicant for reciprocity shall submit proof of ethical compliance, including proof of current licensing and current certification by the certifying entity, along with any other eligibility requirements, such as satisfactory passage of a criminal background check.

exists.quote: the Alabama Behavior Analyst Licensing Board established within the Department of Mental Health is renamed the Alabama Behavior Analyst Advisory Council. The purpose of the advisory council is to advise the department on all matters pertaining to the protection of the health, safety, and welfare of the public relating to licensed behavior analysts

name.quote: the Alabama Behavior Analyst Licensing Board established within the Department of Mental Health is renamed the Alabama Behavior Analyst Advisory Council.

authority.value: Advisory only — advises the department on all matters pertaining to licensed behavior analysts; no license may be denied, suspended, or revoked without a recommendation from the advisory council; Mental Health Commissioner retains final authority.
authority.quote: No license may be denied, suspended, or revoked or an individual otherwise disciplined by the Mental Health Commissioner pursuant to this section without a recommendation from the advisory council.

national_certification.quote: CERTIFYING ENTITY. The nationally accredited Behavior Analyst Certification Board, Incorporated.

credential_type.quote: Each individual desiring to obtain a license shall submit an application and authorized fees to the Mental Health Commissioner.

is_mandatory.quote: The unlicensed practice of behavior analysis is prohibited in this state, unless exempted in subsection (c).

title_protection.quote: No individual shall hold himself or herself out to be a licensed behavior analyst or licensed assistant behavior analyst unless he or she satisfies the applicable requirements of this chapter.

scope_protection.quote: The unlicensed practice of behavior analysis is prohibited in this state, unless exempted in subsection (c).

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a crime the department determines renders the individual unfit to practice as a behavior analyst.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a crime that the department, by rule, determines to be of a nature as to render the individual convicted unfit to practice as a behavior analyst.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the professional and ethical compliance code or the rules adopted pursuant to this chapter.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of the professional and ethical compliance code or the rules adopted pursuant to this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or misrepresentation in obtaining a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or misrepresentation in obtaining a license.

definition_quote.value: The design, implementation, and evaluation of instructional and environmental modifications to produce socially significant improvements in human behavior.
definition_quote.quote: PRACTICE OF BEHAVIOR ANALYSIS. The design, implementation, and evaluation of instructional and environmental modifications to produce socially significant improvements in human behavior.

value: interventions based on scientific research and direct observation and measurement of behavior and environment
use of contextual factors, establishing operations, antecedent stimuli, positive reinforcement, and other consequences
methods_authorized.quote: The empirical identification of functional relations between behavior and environmental factors, known as functional assessment and analysis. Interventions based on scientific research and the direct observation and measurement of behavior and environment, which utilize contextual factors, establishing operations, antecedent stimuli, positive reinforcement, and other consequences

drug_authority.value: Behavior analysts may not prescribe or administer any drug, make a medical diagnosis, provide medical treatment, or manage a medical condition.
drug_authority.quote: Nothing in this chapter shall be construed as permitting or allowing a licensed behavior analyst to prescribe or administer any drug, make a medical diagnosis, provide medical treatment, or manage a medical condition.

tiered_license_levels.quote: LICENSED ASSISTANT BEHAVIOR ANALYST. An individual who is certified by the certifying entity as a national board certified assistant behavior analyst... LICENSED BEHAVIOR ANALYST. An individual who is certified by the certifying entity as a national board certified behavior analyst

national_certification_body.quote: CERTIFYING ENTITY. The nationally accredited Behavior Analyst Certification Board, Incorporated.

national_certification_required_for_lice.quote: a licensed behavior analyst applicant shall also maintain active status as a national board certified behavior analyst, as recognized by the certifying entity, following passage of the national board certified behavior analyst examination

assistant_analyst_supervision_requiremen.value: Licensed assistant behavior analyst must provide proof of ongoing supervision by a licensed behavior analyst who is a current BCBA, in a manner consistent with the requirements of the certifying entity.
assistant_analyst_supervision_requiremen.quote: Provide proof of ongoing supervision by a licensed behavior analyst who is a current national board certified behavior analyst in a manner consistent with the requirements of the certifying entity for supervision of national board certified assistant behavior analysts.

supervisee_technician_exemption.quote: An applied behavior analysis direct contact technician, or family member implementing a behavior analysis plan within the home or other environment in which the individual is located, who acts under the extended authority and direction of a licensed behavior analyst or a licensed assistant behavior analyst.

family_member_caregiver_exemption.quote: family member implementing a behavior analysis plan within the home or other environment in which the individual is located, who acts under the extended authority and direction of a licensed behavior analyst or a licensed assistant behavior analyst.

temporary_license_available.quote: A licensed or unlicensed national board certified behavior analyst or national board certified assistant behavior analyst residing and practicing in another state who temporarily provides behavior analysis services in this state or to a resident of this state, or both, may apply for a temporary license to practice behavior analysis in this state.

organizational_behavior_management_exemp.quote: A behavior analyst who practices with nonhuman or nonpatient clients or consumers including, but not limited to, applied animal behaviorists and practitioners of organizational behavior management.

nonhuman_animal_behaviorist_exemption.quote: A behavior analyst who practices with nonhuman or nonpatient clients or consumers including, but not limited to, applied animal behaviorists and practitioners of organizational behavior management.

value: preventing or alleviating or curing of diseases or injuries
scope_exclusions.quote: The practice of behavior analysis does not include psychological testing, psychotherapy, cognitive therapy, sex therapy, psychoanalysis or hypnotherapy, or long-term counseling as treatment modalities.

prescribing_medical_diagnosis_prohibited.quote: Nothing in this chapter shall be construed as permitting or allowing a licensed behavior analyst to prescribe or administer any drug, make a medical diagnosis, provide medical treatment, or manage a medical condition.

autism_spectrum_disorder_focus.quote: AUTISM. Autism Spectrum Disorder is a neurological and developmental disorder that affects how people interact with others, communicate, learn, and behave.

criminal_background_check_required.quote: Completion of a criminal background check pursuant to rules adopted pursuant to this chapter. The cost of the criminal background check shall be paid by the applicant.

fingerprint_submission_required.quote: An applicant shall submit to the Mental Health Commissioner two complete sets of fingerprints and a form, sworn to by the applicant, containing his or her name, date of birth, and Social Security number for completion of the criminal background check.

ethical_code_compliance_required.quote: Compliance with the professional and ethical compliance code for behavior analysts of the certifying entity.

advisory_board_composition.value: Seven members: four licensed behavior analysts, one licensed psychologist, one parent or legal guardian of an individual treated for a behavior disorder or who received services from a licensed behavior analyst, and one public member appointed by the Mental Health Commissioner.
advisory_board_composition.quote: The advisory council shall consist of seven members, including four licensed behavior analysts, one licensed psychologist in the state, one parent or legal guardian of an individual who has been or is being treated for a behavior disorder or an individual who has received services from a licensed behavior analyst, and one public member who shall be appointed by the Mental Health Commissioner.

board_includes_parent_consumer_member.quote: one parent or legal guardian of an individual who has been or is being treated for a behavior disorder or an individual who has received services from a licensed behavior analyst

board_includes_psychologist_member.quote: one licensed psychologist in the state
